newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish parliament set for first vote on 97 budget.
newsitem.headline: Spanish parliament set for first vote on 97 budget.

text.p: The Spanish parliament is about to take its first vote on the draft 1997 budget, which is already assured of passage.

After speeches on Wednesday, the second day of debate, by smaller regional parties and replies by Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato, the assembly neared the first vote -- a rejection of opposition motions against the budget.
The speeches had already carried over more than 1-1/2 hours past the tentative voting time of 1030 GMT set by speaker Federico Trillo when debate resumed in the morning.
The government is assured of victory on its own votes plus those of its regional allies in Catalonia, the Basque country and the Canary Islands.
